body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Here a chat report from a player who's ban evading. He posted the exact same messages with his spambot and this weird "@a" before the actual message. (Probably a spam bypass?) Here a screenshot of him "spamming" the same on another banned account: https://i.gyazo.com/3431cdcf34f487d633a99d340ee9d1b1.png

Name of player being reported: SkyDroZ91
Rule broken: Ban Evading, Racism
Evidence: https://i.gyazo.com/280bf7535835255e535a61a14ed16949.png https://i.gyazo.com/3431cdcf34f487d633a99d340ee9d1b1.png
Anything else you would like to add? It's racism because "Heil Hitler" means you support Hitler's goals and some of them were racist.

Greetings,
-Atdit

EDIT: Myworld mostlikely will remember it {tag=6248019ce74a42a4bf4b9cf1c189a72d}
